chosen_concept.prompt: A stylised sheltered dune shrub cluster for Lake Michigan / Sleeping Bear dunes style beaches: low rounded clumps of dusty sage-green and olive leaves (bearberry, sand cherry, juniper-like), a few pale twiggy stems, the base sitting in a small mound of pale warm sand. Stylised chunky leaf clusters, not photoreal. No flowers in red. Real size about about 1.2 m tall, 1.6 m wide. Stylised Palworld/Animo-class game prop concept, one coherent family with Quaternius-style medieval/fantasy wood and stone assets: chunky readable shapes, warm weathered driftwood timber, sun-bleached rope, teal and sea-blue paint accents, cream sailcloth, clean hand-painted PBR finish. Use the attached boards only for palette, mood, maritime timber/stone/blue language and finish quality. Absolutely no red, no oxblood, no crimson anywhere. Single isolated object, full object visible, plain neutral light background, no text, no labels, no people, no creatures. This is pure natural vegetation only: NO driftwood, NO rope, NO cloth, NO painted wood, NO man-made objects; ignore the timber, rope, paint and sailcloth accent instructions, they apply to buildings and props only. It is a low WOODY dune shrub thicket: short twisted brown woody branches densely covered in many small oval and needle leaves grouped into soft irregular stylised leaf clumps, like bearberry, sand cherry and common juniper growing together on a Lake Michigan dune. NOT succulents, NOT rosettes, NOT cactus. Wider than tall, sitting on a small pale sand mound.
